name: For The Love Of Sci-Fi
blurb: A Manchester sci-fi and pop-culture convention from Monopoly Events, with past guests such as Karl Urban and Mads Mikkelsen.
notes: Monopoly Events put For the Love of Sci-Fi 'on hold indefinitely' after its 2-3 Dec 2023 edition at Bowlers Exhibition Centre (per Wikipedia, citing a Nov 2023 Monopoly Events statement). The live site is now rebuilding toward a revival at a new venue, BEC Arena, Trafford Park, Manchester ('TBC BEC Arena, Manchester' banner; Guests page shows only a 'tbc.png' placeholder), but as of 2026-10-05 no date has been announced, so editions is empty and the last confirmed edition (2023) is recorded above.
